method: Wrote a fresh verification harness (evidence/phase0/repairs/V-N02a/work/vn02a_verify_sweep.py) that extracts n_active_amine_nh() VERBATIM by source marker from the LIVE, currently-shipped benchmarks/amine-class-active-nh-robustness-v1/compute_amine_class.py -- an independent extraction, not a copy of R-N02's own rn02_property_sweep.py bytes or import. Three legs: (1) re-run the 3 ORIGINAL refuting probes (guanidine CAS 113-00-8, dicyandiamide/DICY CAS 461-58-5, biguanide CAS 461-71-2); refute if any returns nonzero. (2) re-run the full 26-record zero-regression check (3 exact anchors, 6 monodisperse, 13 amine-grid, 7 nonamine controls, 1 hydroxyl probe) with expected n_active_nh values TRANSCRIBED DIRECTLY from R-N02's own already-signed, byte-verified done receipt (zero_regression_evidence.molecule_property_26_records.records), not from any sweep script; refute on any mismatch. (3) construct and run 3 NOVEL amidine-family probes absent from R-N02's probe set, the 26-record regression set, and the sibling role-ranker DPG/DOTG probes: acetamidine (CAS 60-10-6) and benzamidine (CAS 618-39-3), both true amidines whose C=N-bearing carbon is structurally distinct from guanidine's 3-nitrogen N-C(=N)-N core -- chemically-justified expected n_active_nh=0 under the shipped rule's own stated mechanism (the exclusion fires per attached carbon bearing ANY C=N, zeroing all N-H on nitrogens bonded to that carbon, exactly as observed for guanidine's 3 nitrogens) -- plus 2-aminopyridine (CAS 504-29-0) as a deliberately ADVERSARIAL boundary probe: a primary aromatic exocyclic amine, same structural class as aniline (already n_active_nh=2 in the 26-record set), whose ring carbon-nitrogen bond is an AROMATIC bond (RDKit GetBondTypeAsDouble()==1.5) rather than a localized C=N double bond (==2.0) -- chemically-justified expected n_active_nh=2 because the amidine/guanidine lone-pair-into-adjacent-pi-acceptor mechanism the shipped rule targets requires a LOCALIZED C=N pi-acceptor, which an aromatic ring bond is not. This probe would refute R-N02 if the C=N fix over-fired on aromatic systems and silently zeroed a real primary-amine hardener/accelerator component.
objective: INDEPENDENT VERIFY of interactive repair R-N02, per campaign item V-N02a. Did not write R-N02; attacked it. Re-ran the original 3 refuting probes and the 26-record zero-regression check from a FRESH, independent extraction of the currently-shipped n_active_amine_nh() (not a replay of R-N02's own stored sweep bytes or script), then constructed and ran 2+ NOVEL amidine-family probes never used by R-N02 or any prior fire, including one deliberately adversarial boundary case designed to catch over-exclusion.
pre_registered_refute_criterion: This verification would have REFUTED R-N02 if ANY of: (a) any of the 3 original probes (guanidine/DICY/biguanide) returned nonzero n_active_nh under the currently-shipped rule; (b) any of the 26 previously-validated regression records diverged from its own asserted truth value; (c) acetamidine or benzamidine returned nonzero n_active_nh (would show the fix is guanidine-specific, not a genuine categorical amidine/guanidine rule); (d) 2-aminopyridine returned 0 instead of 2 (would show the fix over-fires on aromatic ring systems, silently disqualifying a real primary-amine component that is chemically NOT an amidine/guanidine). None of these occurred; all three legs pass; see rows above for the per-probe/per-record observed values.

why: The R-N02 fix (widening the neighbor-carbon double-bond-partner set from {O,S} to {O,S,N} in n_active_amine_nh's amide/amidine/guanidine exclusion check) generalizes correctly beyond the 3 probes and 26 records it was originally verified against: it correctly zeroes two structurally-distinct novel amidine chemotypes (acetamidine, benzamidine) via the SAME mechanism (carbon bearing an explicit, non-aromatic C=N double bond), and it correctly does NOT zero a chemically-similar-looking but mechanistically-distinct aromatic amine (2-aminopyridine), because RDKit's aromatic bond typing (order 1.5) does not satisfy the rule's ==2.0 double-bond test -- the fix is bounded to the exact physical mechanism it claims (localized C=N lone-pair delocalization) rather than over-firing on any nitrogen-adjacent aromatic ring.
